Stop putting vinegar on granite.

It's the most repeated "natural cleaning" tip online and it's wrong. Acid eats through the sealant. What's left is a dull patch that doesn't polish out.

Warm water, mild dish soap, dry it. That's the whole method.

—

Deja de ponerle vinagre al granito.

Es el consejo "natural" más repetido en internet y está mal. El ácido daña el sellador. Lo que queda es una mancha opaca que ya no se pule.

Agua tibia, jabón suave, y secar. Ese es todo el método.
